desc: Beretta USA, in collaboration with Langdon Tactical Technology, is proud to introduce the 92G Elite LTT II - the next evolution of the ultimate 92 package. Building on Ernest Langdon's decades of competitive shooting expertise, the Elite LTT II integrates a factory-cut of Langdon Tactical's patented Low Mount RDO solution, an Inox slide with refined serrations, an Elite Inox barrel with a combat target crown, and enhanced frame machining. The Vertec grip with wraparound grip module features Beretta's proprietary variable-density checkering for a secure and ergonomic hold.
